description: This file defines the AccessPointArn class in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing and validating AWS S3 access point ARNs.

classes.name: AccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents an AWS S3 Access Point ARN with methods for parsing and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AccessPointArn instance with data and validates it.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into structured data, extracting the access point name.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Returns the access point name from the ARN data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs resource-specific validation on the ARN data, ensuring compliance with expected structure and components.
